title: AI Worker settings file (aiworker.bundle/1)
description: Import: panel «Импорт настроек» or POST /api/v1/import (dry_run first). Never put keys, passwords or tokens in a file.

instruction.description: how the consultant talks and what it may say

content.description: FAQ as «Вопрос: …\nОтвет: …» pairs or free text

knowledge.description: the persona's knowledge: shared by every chat of this persona

required_blocks.description: parts of every reply the owner fixed: verbatim — inserted exactly (⟦block:name⟧), facts — written by the persona and checked by links, must_include and captions

templates.description: template / category names or numbers of the role (applies: templates)

texts.description: language → the exact text; {incoming_link} — the first link of the incoming text

captions.description: language → the owner's exact captions in it

incoming_links.description: the reply must carry the links of the incoming text

content.description: FAQ as «Вопрос: …\nОтвет: …» pairs or free text

knowledge.description: the chat's own sources (older files); new knowledge goes to the persona

allowed_domains.description: sites where the widget may run

kind.description: web — sites in the employee's browser; telegram — groups and channels

goal.description: what to do on every run, in the owner's words; the AI writes the scenario from it when there is no program

criteria.description: what fits: the AI judges every element against it (score 0–100)

targets.description: web: start URLs (https://…, up to 10); telegram: @groups (up to 100)

needs_auth.description: the site needs the owner's login (done by the owner on the employee's desktop)

mode.description: imported as draft; auto is switched on by the owner

every_minutes.description: 0 — only by hand, a webhook or another task's results

webhook.description: a new webhook address is made; the program reads the list «events»

profile.description: about the owner: used in replies and decisions

no_judge.description: every element fits without the AI's judgement (already chosen lists); draft mode still waits for the owner

daily_at.description: every day at this time (HH:MM, the AI employee's time zone), no jitter; every_minutes and hours_* are then ignored

max_actions_per_day.description: external effects per calendar day in the tenant timezone; 0 disables the limit, and is the target after warm-up

min_interval_minutes.description: minimum gap between external effects across runs; 0 disables the limit

warmup_enabled.description: enable the per-task daily quota ramp; requires max_actions_per_day >= 1

warmup_started_at.description: warm-up start date, YYYY-MM-DD; retained when the target changes

interval_jitter_percent.description: during warm-up, add a stable pseudo-random 0..percent extension to min_interval_minutes; 0 disables jitter

event_max_age_minutes.description: queued webhook/trigger event age; older events are skipped as expired; 0 disables expiry

over_limit.description: an action over the pace: defer (default) waits for the next allowed moment, skip drops it

event_overflow.description: when max_queued_events is reached; default keep_oldest skips the incoming event

events_per_run.description: maximum events taken from the queue per run

deliver_to_refs.description: tasks of this file that get this task's results as input events

program.description: optional scenario: {start_url?, steps:[{op, …}]}; ops: use, collection_algorithm, goto, back, reload, check_auth, page_state, dismiss, click, click_text, type, set_value, clear, select, check, press, hover, mouse, scroll, wait, wait_until, get, extract, extract_list, feed, fetch, api, tgstat, telemetr, apify, json_list, storage_get, open_tab, close_tab, download, upload, screenshot, tg_join, tg_fetch, tg_search, tg_send, tg_discover, add_target, audience_fetch, youtube, for_each, if, repeat, break, try, call, jump, pause, stop, set, calc, regex, date, match, filter, dedupe, push, keep, decide, ai, save, notify, agent. Keys only as {{secret.NAME}}. Without a program the AI writes it.

manual_program.description: the program is hand-made: the AI never rewrites it

secret_names.description: names of the keys the program uses; values are entered by the owner

query.description: web: what to look for, e.g. «стоматологии Киев»
